changelog: Docs: link to Ultrahuman MCP repo (Monasterolo21/Ultrahuman-MCP)
summary: Fetch and summarize Ultrahuman Ring/CGM metrics inside OpenClaw using the Ultrahuman MCP server (via mcporter). Use when the user asks about Ultrahuman data such as sleep score, total sleep, sleep stages, HR/HRV/RHR, steps, recovery index, movement index, VO2 max, or wants a daily/weekly Ultrahuman summary.
